If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Toorak, VIC**, here are a few well-reviewed options:

- Stewart Locksmiths (Mobile Only) – Specialises in digital and smart locks, services Toorak and surrounding suburbs, with mobile installation available. Their website also highlights digital lock installation services. [stewartlocksmiths.com.au](https://stewartlocksmiths.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Toorak Locksmith Melbourne – Local locksmith offering lock installation and emergency services.
- South Yarra Locksmiths – 24/7 mobile locksmith serving the Toorak area.
- Digital Door Locks Pty Ltd – Supplies and installs a wide range of smart locks across Melbourne.
- SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – Melbourne-based specialist focused on smart lock supply and installation.

If you already have a smart lock, installation by a locksmith typically costs **around A$150–A$300**, depending on:
- Whether it's a straightforward replacement or a new cut-out is required.
- The door material (timber, aluminium, or steel).
- Whether setup of the app, fingerprints, PINs, or Wi-Fi gateway is included. Community reports for Melbourne installations are generally in this range. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/toorak-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't purchased a lock yet, I can also recommend models that work well with your setup (Apple Home, Google Home, Samsung SmartThings, etc.) and are suitable for Australian doors.
